messages:
marie.devex: starting shiproom for py/ts SDK publish v1.14.0 — plan is staggered: npm canary -> pypi shadow -> final tag in ~2h. pinging @sam.releases for pin guidance and @jason.qe for smoke window. changelog draft: https://go.redwood/rel/1.14.0

sam.releases: ack. quick callouts: we need to pin legacy sync client (1.13.x) for enterprise opts, add deprecation blurb. If any packaging mismatch, hold pypi. keep npm moving if only wheels are affected.

alex.eng: deploy-bot starting canary for npm now — cohort 5%. command run: ```./scripts/publish.sh --package redwood-sdk --canary --cohort=5``` 

deploy-bot: [CI] npm canary publish initiated: redwood-sdk@1.14.0-canary.2025. cohort=5%

jason.qe: i'll run quick smoke on TS client when canary appears in npm. smoke checklist: `npm i redwood-sdk@canary && node ./smoke/smoke-ts.js`

ci-bot: artifact checks: npm tarball checksum ok, wheel build created but PYPI checksum comparison failed (expected != uploaded).

sam.releases: got that — PAUSE pypi. do NOT promote pypi until wheel checksum fixed. action items: unpublish pypi wheel, rebuild wheel with same build env, retest. we should still push npm final if it stays green.

marie.devex: understood. nora.docs — please add deprecation section to release notes and include pin instructions for customers who must stay on sync client: ``pip install redwood-sdk==1.13.7``

nora.docs: on it. i'll add migration snippet + banner. will link to enterprise pinning doc.

alex.eng: rollback plan (if we need it):
1) yank npm dist-tag: `npm dist-tag rm redwood-sdk latest && npm dist-tag add redwood-sdk 1.13.7`
2) revoke pypi release: `twine upload --sign --repository-url ...` (or use pypi UI to remove)
3) create emergency patch branch, revert release commit, republish after fix.

jason.qe: can we run a compatibility smoke for common embedding workflows? i'll run quick embed smoke on canary in 10m.

deploy-bot: npm canary cohort = 5% -> status: OK (requests sampled). promote candidate to 25% cohort now.

ci-bot: re-run packaging sanity after retag attempt: wheel checksum still mismatched on remote pypi. CI suspects a build machine env variance.

sam.releases: decision: promote npm to final in 30m if no regressions. pypi remains paused until wheel is rebuilt. we'll add a note in release notes and in the changelog header: "PYPI: delayed due to packaging verification; wheel reupload pending". Also add instruction to pin legacy sync client.

marie.devex: agreed. sam, can you add the pin snippet in the release notes and a short customer-facing line? i'll also draft an in-product banner for enterprise tenants.

sam.releases: done — release notes updated, doc link: https://go.redwood/docs/release/1.14.0 (draft)

deploy-bot: NPM publish final: redwood-sdk@1.14.0 released. changelog link attached. :shipit:

deploy-bot: PYPI publish: PAUSED — wheel checksum mismatch detected, manual intervention required.

marie.devex: final checklist:
- npm released ✅
- pypi: hold ⛔ (sam to coordinate reupload)
- docs: deprecation + pin instructions ✅ (nora)
- QE: smoke tests queued, will follow up in this thread (jason)
- postmortem followup scheduled tomorrow 10:00 PT (marie)

jason.qe: quick note — TS smoke found intermittent TypeError in v1.14.0-canary when using streaming api. filing tiny bug with stack and test case. recommend delaying final promotion by 15m until I confirm fix isn't needed.

sam.releases: noted. hold npm final for +15m to verify streaming smoke. if streaming fix is a one-line guard, we'll patch and release 1.14.1 tomorrow. otherwise we proceed and roll out patch.

marie.devex: appreciate the caution. update us when smoke is green.

jason.qe: streaming smoke now green on canary after adding guard in client — no server changes. i recommend proceed.

sam.releases: proceeding with npm final now. pypi still blocked until wheel fix. adding enterprise-pin note to changelog header and email to support channel.

marie.devex: thanks everyone. followups: sam to coordinate wheel rebuild, nora to push docs live when pypi is fixed, jason to run regression suite post-reupload. closing shiproom thread, will reopen if anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
